nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (every 15m)
nodes.notes: Synth reminder schedule. Service identity injected from n8n credentials store by ID 'CRM_AUTOMATION_HMAC'. Workflow does NOT store raw secrets.

nodes.name: Build envelope (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: No raw body, PII, or secret in the envelope. Body is the claim; signing happens in HTTP Request node.

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/listDueNextActions
nodes.notes: HMAC signature injected via HMAC credential helper (NOT raw secret). Timeout 5s, 1 retry max, body is the envelope from previous node. REDACTED wire response never carries actor or source.

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/acknowledgeReminder
nodes.notes: Per-item acknowledgement. Idempotency key is per (owner, day) so daily replay dedupes. Timeout 5s.

parameters.content:
## n8n/0.2 — Follow-up / SLA Reminder (INACTIVE DESIGN)

- Calls CRM Automation Gateway (listDueNextActions + acknowledgeReminder) ONLY.
- body organizationId/connectionId are resolved server-side; workflow cannot spoof.
- Local-only credential reference id; raw secret stays in n8n credentials store.
- Timeout 5s per call. Idempotency dedupes by 16-minute window.
- Acknowledgement is audit-only; does NOT mutate NextAction status.

INSTRUCTIONS:
- DO NOT IMPORT into n8n until T0 issues the import command and HRP_AUTOMATION_* env vars + CRM_AUTOMATION_HMAC credential are provisioned by the operator.
- This file is a designed artifact; see docs/contracts/n8n/N8N-0.2/WORKFLOW.md for the contract and activation criteria.
